text: It is used for humans routinely in stem cell transplants and by many humans for all kinds of medical problems, from arthritis to brain injuries (Jacob & de la Torre, 2015). There is evidence (Mitrus, et al, 2018) that using too much DMSO (10% vs 5%) in stem cell transfusions increases mild side effects in adult humans. It hasn't been tested (that I know of, yet) specifically for PTSD, so for PTSD it rests on what people report, and many say it helps.
reader: someone with trauma whose glutamate storms bring anxiety, rage and racing thoughts, going through the protocol's glutamate tools and wanting to know what each does and whether it is safe for them
